subject: Priority signal briefing: action lanes for QBR
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: leadership-distro@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority signal briefing: action lanes for QBR

Team —

TL;DR: Attached is the heatmap and proposed action lanes for the upcoming QBR. Highlights below — please flag any critical omissions by EOD Wednesday so I can fold changes into the final slide pack.

WINS
- ACME Health pilot completed milestone 2; latency and cost targets met in 3/3 test cases.
- Renewals: two mid-market customers signed PO this week (details in the heatmap).
- Dedicated capacity onboarding time reduced to 9 days (pilot improvements).

RISKS
- Model-quantization validation for latency-sensitive paths is behind schedule (QA backlog + infra changes). Risk: potential QBR ask to extend rollout window.
- Procurement delay from ACME (DocuSign outstanding) — may push revenue recognition into next quarter.
- One partner integration (CloudMarket) has API contract drift impacting marketplace listing ETA.

ASKS (clear, owner, due)
- Naomi: Finalize QBR heatmap + slides — need confirmation on any new slides by Wed EOD (attached).
- Vivek: Decision on deferring quantization rollout or moving to canary-only for high-volume customers — due Thu COB.
- Laura: Approve language for customer-facing renewal notice and any discretionary credits for ACME — reply by Thu EOD.
- Markus: Confirm timeline to include marketplace integration as a committed roadmap item for Q3 planning meeting — reply Fri AM.

Attachments: QBR-heatmap-v2.pdf, action-lanes.xlsx (see Drive link below).

Notes: I added a short appendix (slides 12–14) showing trade-offs between canary rollout + cache-first strategy vs. full quantization for latency-sensitive customers.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority signal briefing: action lanes for QBR

Thanks Naomi — good consolidated view.

On the quantization ask: my preference is to avoid broad rollout risk before QA signs off. Can we scope to a canary-only approach for high-volume customers and move full rollout to the next cadence? That keeps us conservative for the QBR while giving sales a concrete path.

If others disagree, say so by Thu COB.

— Vivek
VP, Product & Platform

Subject: Re: Priority signal briefing: action lanes for QBR

Nice work Naomi. A couple quick asks:

- Naomi: can you add a one-slide executive summary with the single-row ask per stakeholder (one-liner + impact)? I want that up front in the pack.
- Procurement: I will review ACME's DocuSign language and propose a customer note; Naomi, please share any suggested credit amounts if needed.
- Scheduling: proposing a 30-minute review with execs on Thu 10:00am PT to sign off on language and slides — can folks confirm availability?

If no major objections, I’ll lock the meeting and circulate the calendar invite.

Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff, Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
